name: sdlc-foundry
description: An agentic SDLC platform: Claude Code agents, slash commands and Copier templates from idea to Kubernetes with GitOps.

plugins.name: svc
plugins.description: Spec-driven pipeline for every service shape: spec → plan → failing acceptance tests → parallel coders → quality ‖ tests ‖ security → verify against the spec → PR.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Agents for Next.js (App Router, pnpm, TypeScript) web repos: coder, tester, deployment, observability, release.

plugins.name: app
plugins.description: Spec-driven features across a product's repos: /app:spec, /app:plan (criteria per repo, contract), /app:build (ready repos in parallel through their own specs), /app:specs.

plugins.name: svc-go
plugins.description: Agents for Go service repos (chi, slog, golangci-lint, distroless): coder, tester, deployment, observability, release.

plugins.name: svc-java
plugins.description: Agents for Java service repos (Spring Boot 3, Maven, JDK 21, distroless): coder, tester, deployment, observability, release.

plugins.name: gitops
plugins.description: Promotion and ApplicationSet management for the GitOps repo (ArgoCD).

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: Common quality and security agents plus the /new-service bootstrap command (shape-aware via shapes.yml).
